instruction.text: Spell the word to find out more about a useful mechanism in our world.
instruction.sound: Spell the word to find out more about a useful mechanism in our world. Pulley.

feedback.end: A pulley is a type of mechanism we use to lift things.

atoms.word: p u l l e y

instruction.text: Every mechanism has certain components. Select the correct parts on the diagram.

hint.label: Axle
hint.text: An axle is the rod that wheels are attached to and turn around.

atoms.b: In a pulley system, a rope goes around a ((++wheel wall)) with a groove in it. The wheel is attached to an ((++axle axe)), so it is able to spin freely. One end of the rope is attached to a ((++load light)).

instruction.text: Which side of the rope should the user apply force to in order to make the mechanism work?
instruction.sound: ssml: Which side of the rope should the user apply force to<break time='1ms'/> in order to make the mechanism work?

feedback.correct: Correct! If you pulled the right side of this rope, the mechanism would change the direction of the force and lift the load.

instruction.text: There are lots of ways of building a pulley, some of which can be very complex. Look at these two pulleys and fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: The left pulley has ((more ++fewer)) wheels than the right pulley.
The left pulley needs ((++10N 5N)) of force to lift the 10N weight.
atoms.sound: The left pulley needs 10 Newtons of force to lift the 10 Newton weight.

atoms.b: The right pulley needs ((more ++less)) force to lift the load.

feedback.end: The more wheels there are in a pulley, the easier it is to lift a load.

instruction.text: Select all the everyday examples of pulleys.
